name: WWE 2K25: Saturday Night's Main Event Pack
summary:
The Saturday Night’s Main Event Pack adds five classic WWE Superstars to WWE 2K25: Jesse “The Body” Ventura, “Mr. Wonderful” Paul Orndorff, Tito Santana, Junk Yard Dog, and Sid Justice. The pack also includes MyFACTION cards for each Superstar so they can be used in that mode as well.

It is the fifth and final DLC character pack included with WWE 2K25 Season Pass and Ringside Pass, and it comes with select editions including Deadman and The Bloodline Editions
